description: State Highway Administration Catalogs Vulnerabilities is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Maryland Department of Transportation | State Highway Administration; DOT Federal Highway Administration; Salisbury University | Eastern Shore Regional GIS Cooperative. Using a collection of tools, Maryland has begun identifying which of its roads and bridges are vulnerable to climate-related events. Coverage: Maryland (2015). The toolkit gives Maryland as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
